blocks.source: 【ダンジョンRPG】Labyrinth Star
blocks.translation: [Dungeon RPG] Labyrinth Star

blocks.source: 2011年7月頃から作成していた作品が完成しましたので公開致します。戦闘重視のダンジョンＲＰＧで、プレイ時間は10～15時間程度です。RPGツクール2000製ですが、各システムや素材を自作していますので、ツクール2000は食傷気味という人でも大丈夫かと思います。
blocks.translation: The game I had been working on since around July 2011 is now complete, so I am releasing it. It is a battle-focused dungeon RPG with an estimated playtime of 10–15 hours. It was made with RPG Maker 2000, but I created all of the systems and assets myself, so I think it should still be enjoyable even for those who are tired of RPG Maker 2000 games.

blocks.source: （ファイルサイズ：約20MB）
blocks.translation: (File size: approximately 20 MB)

blocks.source: （ダウンロードして展開後、本体があるフォルダ内にパッチの中身をコピー＆上書きしてください。上の本体にも反映済です。）
blocks.translation: (After downloading and extracting the patch, copy its contents into the folder containing the game and overwrite the existing files. The patch has already been applied to the main download above.)

blocks.source: 古い作品なので現在のWindows環境では起動時にエラー（DirctDraw Error）が発生する模様です。
blocks.translation: Since this is an old game, it apparently produces an error (DirctDraw Error) on startup in current Windows environments.

blocks.source: なお、本作は将来的なリメイク版（リマスターに近いかも？ 英語対応予定）の開発を計画しています。そちらを待って頂いてもよいかと思います。なお、まだ計画段階なので詳細は決まっていません。
blocks.translation: I am also planning to develop a future remake of this game (perhaps closer to a remaster? English support is planned). You may want to wait for that version. However, it is still only in the planning stage, so the details have not yet been decided.

blocks.source: こちらはリメイク版もフリゲにする予定です。完成はどんなに早くても２０２７年末以降になる予定です。
blocks.translation: The remake is also planned to be released as freeware. It is scheduled for completion no earlier than the end of 2027.

blocks.source: 解凍した本体フォルダの中にあるRPG_RT.exe
blocks.translation: RPG_RT.exe in the extracted game folder

blocks.source: を実行してください。全画面モードで起動します。ウィンドウモードでプレイしたい場合はF4を押してください。
blocks.translation: and run it. It will start in fullscreen mode. Press F4 if you want to play in windowed mode.

blocks.source: このゲームは通常のWindows環境ならば単体で動作します。RTPなどのインストールは不要です。
blocks.translation: This game runs standalone in a normal Windows environment. No installation of RTP or anything else is required.

blocks.source: 少しだけ複雑なシステムなので、同梱の説明書（
blocks.translation: Since the system is somewhat complex, I tried to write the included manual (

blocks.source: ）をできるだけ丁寧に書いてみました。ゲーム中でも人物のセリフを通して、システムの説明をしていますが、わかリにくいという場合は説明書をご覧ください。
blocks.translation: ) as carefully as possible. The system is also explained through the characters' dialogue during the game, but if you find it difficult to understand, please consult the manual.

blocks.source: 以下内容紹介
blocks.translation: Features

blocks.source: ・１２の職業（性別有）から４人のパーティを作成可能です。
blocks.translation: ・You can create a party of four from 12 classes (with selectable genders).

blocks.source: ・舞台は秘宝が眠ると言われる迷宮がある孤島。
blocks.translation: ・The setting is an isolated island containing a labyrinth said to hold a precious treasure.

blocks.source: ・秘宝を求めて、入る度に構造が変わる迷宮を探索。
blocks.translation: ・Explore a labyrinth whose layout changes every time you enter, in search of the treasure.

blocks.source: ・シンボルエンカウント制を採用。シンボルは魔物によって異なります。
blocks.translation: ・The game uses a symbol encounter system. Symbols differ depending on the monster.

blocks.source: ・戦闘はCTB形式を採用しています。画面右に行動順序が表示されます。
blocks.translation: ・Battles use a CTB system. The action order is displayed on the right side of the screen.

blocks.source: ・戦闘テンポにはかなり力を入れており、軽快に進行します。
blocks.translation: ・A great deal of effort has gone into the battle pacing, allowing battles to progress briskly.

blocks.source: ・細部までこだわったゲームバランスにより、快適性と手応えの双方を追求しています。
blocks.translation: ・Through carefully refined game balance, the game pursues both comfort and a satisfying challenge.

blocks.source: ・魔法・特技及び戦闘アニメの数はＳＦＣ時代の市販ＲＰＧ並です。
blocks.translation: ・The number of spells, Techs, and battle animations is comparable to that of commercial RPGs from the Super Famicom era.

blocks.source: ・メニュー画面も独自に実装しています。0.5秒以内で開くようにするなど、軽快に動作するように気を付けています。
blocks.translation: ・The menu screen has also been implemented from scratch. Care has been taken to make it operate smoothly, such as opening within 0.5 seconds.

blocks.source: ・敵を倒して得た魔石を合成してできる『魔珠』を装備することで、キャラクターのカスタマイズが可能です。
blocks.translation: ・Characters can be customized by equipping “mage orbs,” created by combining the magic stones obtained from defeated enemies.

blocks.source: ・魔物図鑑を実装。敵毎に入手できる魔石の種類が異なるので、特定の敵を狙って倒すといった戦略も可能です。
blocks.translation: ・A monster encyclopedia is included. Since each enemy provides different types of magic stones, strategies such as targeting and defeating specific enemies are possible.

blocks.source: ・作者なりにできる範囲でストーリーも頑張ったつもりです。とはいえ、あくまでゲーム性重視、特に戦闘システム重視の作品です。ストーリー等を期待する方のご期待には添えないかもしれません。
blocks.translation: ・I have also put as much effort into the story as I could within my abilities. That said, this is ultimately a game-focused work, with particular emphasis on the battle system. It may not meet the expectations of those looking for a strong story or similar elements.

blocks.source: ・迷宮をうろつく手強い賞金首を退治すると、報酬が手に入ります。
blocks.translation: ・Defeat the formidable bounty hunters roaming the labyrinth to receive rewards.

blocks.source: 開発に当たって、多数の方が作成したフリー素材やフリーソフトを利用させて頂きました。感謝致します。詳細は添付の説明書に明記しております。
blocks.translation: In developing this game, I used free assets and freeware created by many people. I am grateful to them. Details are provided in the included manual.

blocks.source: 修正履歴
blocks.translation: Revision History

blocks.source: ・作品公開
blocks.translation: ・Game released

blocks.source: ・説明書にて、踊子の属性が間違っていたのを修正。
blocks.translation: ・Corrected an incorrect attribute for the Dancer in the manual.

blocks.source: ・酒場での選択肢の誤字を修正。
blocks.translation: ・Corrected a typo in the choices at the tavern.

blocks.source: ・酒場で仲間と別れる際の選択肢にて『は行』『ば行』など、一部の文字が表示されない不具合修正。
blocks.translation: ・Fixed a bug where some characters, such as the “ha” and “ba” rows, were not displayed in the choices for parting ways with companions at the tavern.

blocks.source: ・酒場で仲間と別れた際、及びクリア後にメンバー情報を引き継がずに開始した場合に
blocks.translation: ・When parting ways with companions at the tavern, or when starting after clearing the game without carrying over member information,

blocks.source: 特技情報が正しく初期化されない不具合を修正。
blocks.translation: fixed a bug where Tech information was not initialized correctly.

blocks.source: ・セーブ画面のＨＰ表記に魔珠や主人公特典による補正分を含むように修正。
blocks.translation: ・Adjusted the HP display on the save screen to include bonuses from mage orbs and the protagonist bonus.

blocks.source: ・デルタスパークのダメージが０の時に数値表示されないのを修正。
blocks.translation: ・Fixed an issue where no damage value was displayed when Delta Spark dealt 0 damage.

blocks.source: ・戦闘終了後に一瞬、敵シンボルの動きを停止するように調整。
blocks.translation: ・Adjusted the game so that enemy symbols stop moving briefly after battle ends.

blocks.source: ・１人旅でクリア後、引継処理にてエラーになる不具合修正。
blocks.translation: ・Fixed a bug that caused an error during the carryover process after clearing the game while traveling alone.

blocks.source: ・ver1.03に全滅時にエラーとなる不具合があったため修正。
blocks.translation: ・Fixed a bug in ver1.03 that caused an error when the entire party was defeated.

blocks.source: ・戦闘・メニューの操作などで、たまに連射が掛かる不具合に対応。
blocks.translation: ・Addressed a bug that occasionally caused rapid-fire input during battles and menu operations.

blocks.source: ・戦闘中の入替時に名前表示がおかしくなる不具合を修正。
blocks.translation: ・Fixed a bug that caused names to be displayed incorrectly when switching members during battle.

blocks.source: ・戦闘不能時に暴走・魔鏡などの永続効果が解除される不具合を修正。
blocks.translation: ・Fixed a bug where persistent effects such as Berserk and Magic Mirror were removed when a character became incapacitated.

blocks.source: ・ブラインドカット（ダメージ＋暗闇）など複合効果を持つ技を使用して、戦闘を終えた後、メニューでレアヤークを使用すると回復処理が行われない不具合修正。
blocks.translation: ・Fixed a bug where recovery did not occur when, after using a technique with combined effects such as Blind Cut (damage + blind) and finishing the battle, Rare Yark was used from the menu.

blocks.source: ・戦闘・メニューの操作等で、たまに連射が掛かる不具合をさらに修正。（環境依存？）
blocks.translation: ・Further fixed the bug that occasionally caused rapid-fire input during battles and menu operations. (Possibly environment-dependent?)

blocks.source: （まだ、発生するようならば連絡ください。）
blocks.translation: (Please contact me if it still occurs.)

blocks.source: ・敵が回復魔法を使用する際に、味方に対して掛けてしまう事がある不具合修正。
blocks.translation: ・Fixed a bug where enemies sometimes cast healing spells on allies.

blocks.source: ・スピードスラスト等の行動時間短縮技と武器追加効果が重なった場合、行動時間短縮効果が無くなってしまう不具合修正。
blocks.translation: ・Fixed a bug where action-time reduction effects disappeared when techniques such as Speed Thrust overlapped with additional weapon effects.

blocks.source: ・戦闘終了後、稀にダンジョン曲のテンポがおかしくなる不具合修正。
blocks.translation: ・Fixed a bug where the tempo of the dungeon music occasionally became incorrect after battle.

blocks.source: ・一人旅時のセリフを修正。他誤字修正。
blocks.translation: ・Corrected dialogue when traveling alone, along with other typos.

blocks.source: ・ブラウザ設定がフレーム未対応でも、説明書.htmlにリンク先を表示するようにした。
blocks.translation: ・Even if the browser settings do not support frames, the link destination is now displayed in Manual.html.

blocks.source: ・魔物図鑑の敵ＨＰが10000以上の場合も表示できるように修正。
blocks.translation: ・Fixed an issue where enemy HP of 10000 or more could not be displayed in the Monster Encyclopedia.

blocks.source: ・ブラインドカット等の追加効果技は攻撃が外れると、追加効果も外れるように統一。
blocks.translation: ・Standardized skills with additional effects, such as Blind Cut, so that the additional effect also misses when the attack misses.

blocks.source: ・沈黙状態だと、ヒートボディの反撃に失敗する不具合修正。
blocks.translation: ・Fixed an issue where Heat Body's counterattack failed while silenced.

blocks.source: ・毒状態だと、逃走に失敗する不具合修正。
blocks.translation: ・Fixed an issue where escape attempts failed while poisoned.

blocks.source: ・陣形選択後の入替時に左右キーを押すと、カーソルが変な所に移動する不具合修正。
blocks.translation: ・Fixed an issue where pressing the left or right key while switching party members after selecting a formation moved the cursor to an incorrect position.

blocks.source: ・変換の星珠の効果がクリア後の引継時に、OFFになるように修正。
blocks.translation: ・Changed the Conversion Star Orb's effect to turn OFF when carried over after clearing the game.

blocks.source: ・ＴＰ１～３の魔珠が店に出ない不具合修正。
blocks.translation: ・Fixed an issue where the TP 1–3 mage orbs did not appear in shops.

blocks.source: ・追加効果技は攻撃が外れると、追加効果も外れるように統一。の漏れ分修正。
blocks.translation: ・Fixed the cases missed in standardizing skills with additional effects so that the additional effect also misses when the attack misses.

blocks.source: ・ヒートボディを魔法反射する様に修正。
blocks.translation: ・Changed Heat Body so that it can be reflected by Magic Reflect.

blocks.source: ・誤字修正。
blocks.translation: ・Fixed typos.

blocks.source: ・神官女の正面歩行グラフィックの腕振りがおかしいのを修正。
blocks.translation: ・Fixed the incorrect arm movement in the front-facing walking graphic of the female priest.

blocks.source: ・最終エリアにて階段を降りた際、稀に謎の十字空間に飛ぶのを修正。
blocks.translation: ・Fixed an issue where descending the stairs in the final area would sometimes send the player to a mysterious cross-shaped area.

blocks.source: 【未対応】
blocks.translation: [Not addressed]

blocks.source: ・稀に敵シンボルが侵入できないはずの壁や空中にいる。（現象未確認）
blocks.translation: ・Rarely, enemy symbols appear inside walls or in midair, where they should not be able to enter. (Phenomenon unconfirmed)

blocks.source: ・戦闘時に敵グラフィックが変な重なり方をすることがある。
blocks.translation: ・Enemy graphics may sometimes overlap strangely during battle.

blocks.source: （ある程度対応したのですが、残っている箇所があるかもしれません。）
blocks.translation: (I addressed this to some extent, but there may still be some remaining areas.)

texts.・デルタスパークのダメージが０の時に数値表示されないのを修正。: ・Fixed an issue where no damage value was displayed when Delta Spark dealt 0 damage.
texts.・戦闘終了後に一瞬、敵シンボルの動きを停止するように調整。: ・Adjusted the game so that enemy symbols stop moving briefly after battle ends.
texts.・１人旅でクリア後、引継処理にてエラーになる不具合修正。: ・Fixed a bug that caused an error during the carryover process after clearing the game while traveling alone.
texts.・ver1.03に全滅時にエラーとなる不具合があったため修正。: ・Fixed a bug in ver1.03 that caused an error when the entire party was defeated.
texts.・戦闘・メニューの操作などで、たまに連射が掛かる不具合に対応。: ・Addressed a bug that occasionally caused rapid-fire input during battles and menu operations.
texts.・戦闘中の入替時に名前表示がおかしくなる不具合を修正。: ・Fixed a bug that caused names to be displayed incorrectly when switching members during battle.
texts.・戦闘不能時に暴走・魔鏡などの永続効果が解除される不具合を修正。: ・Fixed a bug where persistent effects such as Berserk and Magic Mirror were removed when a character became incapacitated.
texts.・ブラインドカット（ダメージ＋暗闇）など複合効果を持つ技を使用して、戦闘を終えた: ・Fixed a bug where recovery did not occur when, after using a technique with combined effects such as Blind Cut (damage + blind) and finishing the battle, Rare Yark was used from the menu.
texts.・戦闘・メニューの操作等で、たまに連射が掛かる不具合をさらに修正。（環境依存？）: ・Further fixed the bug that occasionally caused rapid-fire input during battles and menu operations. (Possibly environment-dependent?)
texts.（まだ、発生するようならば連絡ください。）: (Please contact me if it still occurs.)
texts.・敵が回復魔法を使用する際に、味方に対して掛けてしまう事がある不具合修正。: ・Fixed a bug where enemies sometimes cast healing spells on allies.
texts.・スピードスラスト等の行動時間短縮技と武器追加効果が重なった場合、行動時間短縮効: ・Fixed a bug where action-time reduction effects disappeared when techniques such as Speed Thrust overlapped with additional weapon effects.
texts.・戦闘終了後、稀にダンジョン曲のテンポがおかしくなる不具合修正。: ・Fixed a bug where the tempo of the dungeon music occasionally became incorrect after battle.
texts.・一人旅時のセリフを修正。他誤字修正。: ・Corrected dialogue when traveling alone, along with other typos.
texts.・ブラウザ設定がフレーム未対応でも、説明書.htmlにリンク先を表示するようにし: ・Even if the browser settings do not support frames, the link destination is now displayed in Manual.html.
texts.・魔物図鑑の敵ＨＰが10000以上の場合も表示できるように修正。: ・Fixed an issue where enemy HP of 10000 or more could not be displayed in the Monster Encyclopedia.
texts.・ブラインドカット等の追加効果技は攻撃が外れると、追加効果も外れるように統一。: ・Standardized skills with additional effects, such as Blind Cut, so that the additional effect also misses when the attack misses.
texts.・沈黙状態だと、ヒートボディの反撃に失敗する不具合修正。: ・Fixed an issue where Heat Body's counterattack failed while silenced.
texts.・毒状態だと、逃走に失敗する不具合修正。: ・Fixed an issue where escape attempts failed while poisoned.
texts.・陣形選択後の入替時に左右キーを押すと、カーソルが変な所に移動する不具合修正。: ・Fixed an issue where pressing the left or right key while switching party members after selecting a formation moved the cursor to an incorrect position.
texts.・変換の星珠の効果がクリア後の引継時に、OFFになるように修正。: ・Changed the Conversion Star Orb's effect to turn OFF when carried over after clearing the game.
texts.・ＴＰ１～３の魔珠が店に出ない不具合修正。: ・Fixed an issue where the TP 1–3 mage orbs did not appear in shops.
texts.・追加効果技は攻撃が外れると、追加効果も外れるように統一。の漏れ分修正。: ・Fixed the cases missed in standardizing skills with additional effects so that the additional effect also misses when the attack misses.
texts.・ヒートボディを魔法反射する様に修正。: ・Changed Heat Body so that it can be reflected by Magic Reflect.
texts.・神官女の正面歩行グラフィックの腕振りがおかしいのを修正。: ・Fixed the incorrect arm movement in the front-facing walking graphic of the female priest.
texts.・最終エリアにて階段を降りた際、稀に謎の十字空間に飛ぶのを修正。: ・Fixed an issue where descending the stairs in the final area would sometimes send the player to a mysterious cross-shaped area.
texts.・稀に敵シンボルが侵入できないはずの壁や空中にいる。（現象未確認）: ・Rarely, enemy symbols appear inside walls or in midair, where they should not be able to enter. (Phenomenon unconfirmed)
texts.・戦闘時に敵グラフィックが変な重なり方をすることがある。: ・Enemy graphics may sometimes overlap strangely during battle.
texts.（ある程度対応したのですが、残っている箇所があるかもしれません。）: (I addressed this to some extent, but there may still be some remaining areas.)
